svg.title: Two paths after a bug report: keyword search versus agent search
svg.desc: Two horizontal flows. The top flow shows an English bug report going through a keyword search for "search provider save", which surfaces a Chinese-language report through its English identifiers, a match the reporter cannot confirm, and a duplicate issue that a maintainer merges weeks later. The bottom flow shows the same report going through an agent that reads the hit, confirms the match, and files no duplicate.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What happens to the same bug report
